replay_card.before: Alabama delegates met in Montgomery in January 1861 to consider secession amid the wider U.S. secession crisis. This card does not infer delegate motive beyond sourced records.
replay_card.during: On January 11, 1861, the Alabama Secession Convention adopted the Ordinance of Secession by a recorded vote of 61 ayes to 39 nays.
replay_card.after: Alabama thereafter entered the Confederate political project. Consequences, military events, slavery, Unionism, Reconstruction, and later memory remain separate atomic claims and are not imported into this card.
replay_card.public_history_note: The replay preserves only the documented civic act, date, and vote. It does not convert the synthetic GENERAL_LEE role into a historical person, rank, command, endorsement, or authority.
